notes: the chain reaches Qasim, who writes in the first person «دخلت على عائشة فقلت يا أمه اكشفي لي»: Aisha is asked and answers by an act, «فكشفت لي», so the link is not settled (rule 11: a first-person narrative with implicit transmission); she is not added
«قال أبو علي يقال إن رسول الله ... مقدم» is an appended remark, not a route
